strings.gwipeConfirm:
⚠️ Full Google wipe:

• Clears Play Store + Google Play services + Services Framework data.
• ⛔ You WILL be signed out of Google accounts (you must re-add them).
• Your photos and apps are untouched.
• The device reboots automatically after.

Are you sure?

strings.mdKbSmart: • Keto boksi mar kiyi ma riek: ng’iyo boksi mar kiyi ma sani ka iporo gi listi mar Google mar weyo (CRL) kendo otemo yore mang’eny nyaka oyud boksi mar kiyi ma tiyo, ka en gi backup ma otomatike kendo ma chako kendo tich mar Google. Otiyo gi tap moro amora kendo dwaro intanet (dakika 1-3).
strings.mdKbNet: • Boks mar kido ma wuok e mbui: ng’ado boksi mar kido ma wuok e mbui (GitHub) kendo oketo e /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Odwaro intanet kendo okawo dakika 1-3. Ne otiyogo sama ng’at ma ng’ado bura mariek ok tiyo maber kata sama ne oloko sanduk mar kiyi gi lwedo.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP diagnosis: checks the available Remote Key Provisioning modules, inspects the TEE attestation certificate version, and shows the KmInstallKeybox tool state. Changes nothing — a plain device status view.
strings.mdWvDiag: • ng’iyo (somo kende): nyiso gik ma nyiso ni ng’ato nigi rang’iny mar ng’ato () ma wuok kuom dumpsys, bedo ni nitie fail mar DRM (IDM), kod gik ma tudruok gi sistemno. Ok olok gimoro amora kata matin.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Loso mar buk mar ng’ato: otiyo gi buk mar ng’ato. Oloso weche mag ng’ado bura ka pas ma otomatik ok tiyo. Run moro amora loso lain maler mar loch/rach.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Full RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh full. Handles the hard cases and takes longer. A clear result appears at the end.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Keto kendo GMS: golo Play Store kod Google data mag tich (GMS+GSF) kendo chako kendo masinno owuon. Kaka ng’at ma ng’iyo gik moko kende — ok omul piche kata fainde magi.
strings.mdCertify: • Chiwo oboke mar tugo: ng’iyo chal mar oboke mar RKP mar masin kendo oketo kendo gik ma oboke ka dwarore. Ok omulo data mar ng’at ma tiyo kode.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER loso: loso Google chenro mar tich (SOTER) weche ma tudore gi ng’ado bura kuom gik ma itiyogo. Ne otiyogo ne gik moko ma ne geno SOTER kar tiyo kod ng’eyo malong’o.
strings.mdPifApply: • Ti kod PIF: ng’ado teko mar sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh. Otiyo gi ranyisi mar lwedo ma oyier (ma ni e alwora/ma odhi nyime) kendo odwoko fainde mag pif.prop/pif.json. Duoko maler nenore e log.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF ng’iyo: nyiso chal mar injin ma oseket, fainde mag ranyisi mag lwedo (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), kod weche ma ondiki. Chek kende — ok olok gimoro.
strings.mdCanary: • Oboke mar Kanari: otiyo gi sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Okawo injin ma nyasani ma ne ogol mondo one ni owinjore gi oboke ma nyaka yud RKP (dwe mar ariyo 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Engine diagnosis: checks the TrickyStoreOSS state (pid, logs), the keybox files (active vs user), the real vs spoofed device fingerprint, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP keys. Diagnostic display only.

strings.hintKbSlots: Modulno rito kuonde ariyo mag kiboke: madongo (maler, ma ok orum kata matin) kod mar ariyo (ma rito). Tab ni nyiso ni en slot mane ma tiyo, loko dwaro, kata loso mar ariyo nyaka mar ariyo ka ng’ato okwayo maler — gi backups kod log ma opong’o.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Rang’o tim makare: ng’iyo TEE kido ma ikelo, ng’at ma iketo e laibri e iye mar kido2, chal mar weyo (CRL), ng’at ma oting’o list mar rito kod chal mar RKP. <2Zepa> Somo kende — ok olok gimoro.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe re-apply:

• The protection list is rebuilt from every installed app.
• The custom-ROM compatibility layer is re-applied.
• The active keybox is re-applied.
• Google Play services are restarted.

Nothing is deleted and the primary keybox is never touched.

Continue?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Slot mag keybox: nyiso chal mar slot madongo kod madongo kendo loko gima idwaro e kindgi. Gima duong’ (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) kinde duto oriti kendo ok ogol kata matin. Medo ng’at ma ariyo nyaka ma duong’ dwaro ni ng’ato oket adier maler.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote: ⬆️ Keto slot mar ariyo nyaka e slot maduong’: /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml bedo gik ma ni e slot maduong’.

strings.confirmKbSmart:
Smart keybox fetch (new in v3.17):

• Checks the current keybox against the Google revocation list (CRL).
• Tries multiple sources until a clean keybox is found.
• Automatic backup + restarts Google services.

⚠️ Needs internet (1-3 min). Continue?
strings.confirmKbNet:
Fetch keybox from the internet:

• Downloads the official keybox and validates it.
• Installed permanently (never reverted at boot).

⚠️ Needs internet (up to 1 min). Continue?
strings.confirmRkpManual: Onge data kata fainde mag boksi mar kido ma ogol.
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Full repair:

• Re-provisions RKP + restarts Google services.
• The device reboots automatically (nothing is wiped).

Continue?
strings.confirmGmsReset:
Restart Google services:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — restart only.
• Nothing is wiped and you will NOT be signed out.
• The device reboots automatically.

Continue?
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Force re-provision (Red Magic):

• For devices that ignore the leaked keybox.
• Works even if the keys are healthy.
• No data is deleted.

Continue?
strings.confirmCertify: Ogolo mana gik ma oting’o e duka — akaunt mari pok omulo.
strings.confirmSoter:
Ochako kendo tich mar vendor.soter.Ogolo data mar sava kende.

Dhi nyime?
strings.confirmPifApply:
Apply fingerprint (PIF):

• Converts custom.pif.prop and installs it into the engine path.
• Requires a reboot afterwards.

Continue?
strings.confirmCanary:
Update Canary fingerprint:

• Downloads the latest official Canary fingerprint from Google.
• Syncs the security patch + restarts Google services (no wipe).

⚠️ Needs internet (1-3 min). Continue?
